entries.title: Space Haven

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Space Haven left Early Access and reached full Steam release on May 13, 2026, with Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS support plus Workshop and Steam Cloud features. It is a spaceship colony sim inspired by RimWorld, Dwarf Fortress, Spacebase DF-9, and Oxygen Not Included. No console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the main archive route because it has the cleanest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam 1.0 release. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched 1.0 build.
